findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed multiple areas in the physical facility needing repair:
1) SECOND REPEAT: Under the left side of the sink at the dish machine there are multiple tiles that have come loose from the wall.
2) SECOND REPEAT: The bar hand-sink needs sealed to the wall. Facilities that cannot be moved for cleaning should be adhered to the wall to prevent the entry and harborage of mold.
3) FIRST REPEAT There are tiles underneath the dry storage along the north wall of the kitchen have separated from the wall.
Ensure repairs are made by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed shrimp being thawed in the basin of the hand washing sink next to the kitchen office. CORRECTED- shrimp was removed from the sink. Ensure hand washing sinks are used for no other purpose than hand washing, so as to not deter hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed multiple areas in the facility needing repair:
1) FIRST REPEAT: Under the left side of the sink at the dish machine there are multiple tiles that have come loose from the wall.
2) FIRST REPEAT: The bar hand-sink needs caulked to the wall. Facilities that cannot be moved for cleaning should be adhered to the wall to be made smooth and easily cleanable.
3) There are tiles underneath the dry storage along the north wall of the kitchen have separated from the wall.
Ensure repairs are made by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Allergen awareness training for CFPM
findings.comment:
FIRST REPEAT: None of the facility’s Certified Food Protection Managers (CFPM)s have allergen awareness certificates. Allergen Awareness information (given during the previous inspection) is in black binder with the other paperwork. Certified Food Protection Managers are required to obtain allergen awareness training in Class I facilities. Certificates must be renewed every 3 years.

410 ILCS 625/3.07(b). Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Training programs must be accredited by the American National Standards Institute or another reputable accreditation agency under the ASTM International E2659-09 (Standard Practice for Certificate Programs). There is no limit to how many times an employee may take the training.[C]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the basin of the  handwashing sink at the facility’s bar to be obstructed by a container of Clorox wipes. CORRECTED- the wipes were removed. Ensure handwashing sinks are made available for handwashing only at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.[Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Multiple food contact surfaces were found to contain an accumulation of soil debris:
1) Back of the ice baffles in the large server prep room.
2) Soda nozzles of the bar server station.
CORRECTED- the ice machine was emptied and wiped with a clean sanitizer rag. The soda nozzles were removed to be cleaned, brushed, and sanitized.
Ensure food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of soil debris. This frequency may need to increase with use and variable outdoor temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed multiples areas in the facility needing repair:
1) Under the left side of the sink at the dish machine there are multiple tiles that have come loose from the wall.
2) The walls on either side of the mop sink contain exposed wood. Ensure the walls are covered with a smooth, easily cleanable surface to prevent the harborage of mold. 
3) The bar hand-sink needs caulked to the wall. Facilities that cannot be moved for cleaning should be adhered to the wall to be made smooth and easily cleanable.
Ensure repairs are made by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Allergen awareness training for CFPM
findings.comment:
None of the facility’s CFMs have allergen awareness certificates. Discussion was had between inspector and PIC, and inspector gave the PIC a list of accredited institutes for allergen awareness training. Certified Food Protection Managers are required to obtain allergen awareness training. 

410 ILCS 625/3.07(b). Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Training programs must be accredited by the American National Standards Institute or another reputable accreditation agency under the ASTM International E2659-09 (Standard Practice for Certificate Programs). There is no limit to how many times an employee may take the training.[C]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: The manager’s Certified Food Protection Manager’s certificate recently expired and they have not retaken the test yet. Ensure that there is always a CFPM on site during all hours of operation. The PIC stated that he will be taking it soon and did not realize that it had expired.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The dish shelves were observed to be in need of cleaning. Ensure that these are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There is a piece of wall trim that is in disrepair to the right of the triple sink. Ensure that this is repaired and maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: There was raw meat observed to be stored above potatoes and rolls in the walk-in cooler. CORRECTED- The raw meat was moved from above these items and staff was educated on storage order. Ensure that food is protected from cross contamination during storage and holding. 

 (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P).

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: There was a leak observed in the triple sink faucet. Ensure that this leak is repaired by next routine inspection. Plumbing systems should be maintained in good repair. 

A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Conveyor belt dish machine final rinse observed reaching less than 160F, according to the a heat-sensing sticker and inspector’s plate thermometer. PIC restarted the booster, at which time the machine reached at least 160F on the heat sensing sticker and 180F on the machine’s built-in baffle thermometer.
4-501.112: (A) Temperature of the fresh hot water SANITIZING rinse may not be more than 194F or less than 160F for stationary rack, single temperature machines. All other machines can be no less than 180F. (B) Maximum temperature does not apply to high pressure and temperature systems with wand-type spraying devices. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: No ambient thermometer is present in the 2 door cooler near the back door. CORRECTED- A thermometer was moved from the out-of-use salad bowl cooler. Ensure thermometers are present in all cold holding equipment. (Previously observed 10/25/2023.)
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. [C]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
There is a gap along the bottom of the windowed back door where daylight is visible when the door is shut. Add a sweep or otherwise close the gap so that the door is tight-fitting and protected against pests.
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent. [C]
